::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 21st [1860?]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Pierpont Morgan Library, New York, MA 4500
:::

Sir

I have carefully read the MSS with which you have favored me. I have sent the very amusing school story to be inspected for the [Magazine for the Young](organizations/other_79.qmd), and will let you know the answer as soon as I receive it. The Idle Word and We Must Submit I should be glad to retain for the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd).[^1] ‘Is it False’ I think I had better return at once, as though a very good story, it is not suited to the Monthly Packet.

I am afraid that the MSS will hardly come out of the printers hands in a state in which you would like to preserve them. Would you prefer having them returned so as to get them copied?

yours &amp;c

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: They do not seem to have been published there under these titles.
